question: Why do some fail to recognize akulavīra despite its presence?
premises: Akulavīra is the object to be known
Their selves are deluded by artificial means
inference: Those deluded by artificial means fail to recognize akulavīra.
uncertainties: kṛtakaiḥ may refer to artificial practices, constructs, or substances
plain_english: Those whose selves are deluded by artificial means do not know akulavīra.
